title: Sui fresh cluster — AlphaFi Lending, DipCoin, Bluefin Pro, Kai Finance, Suigar

every old-only function cluster-wide is public(friend)/private, never entry/public

old package versions resolve to their OWN module set (differential simulateTransaction proof, 5 families)
across 7 package families ZERO existing structs changed first->latest (layout gate never protects old code)

one_liner: external unprivileged attacker can extract ~$0 live from the five fresh Sui targets; the version/import primitive is structurally live (old versions callable, structs stable) and four of five rely on effective object version gates, while Bluefin's gate is a no-op yet its v1 entry points still enforce signatures and its 0x05->0x0 signer bypass has no profit path.
